notes.title: In-game leaderboards!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26867867/0ebe3bcd6c1b82e13833ab0a7199c728736f287f.jpg[/img]   [img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26867867/28bb6af6afbfbc7c56196bd264664e54e7057847.jpg[/img]

[h1]In-game leaderboards[/h1]
The new update for Wondee adds in-game leaderboard information. Now you can see your rank after every game and browse the leaderboards without leaving the game!

[b]Build 56 notes[/b]
[list]
[*]Added in-game Steam leaderboard rankings. 
[*]Mouse UI navigation - Now the UI can be used by mouse, keyboard, and gamepad fully.
[*]Minor UI performance improvements
[/list]
